thread_text:
1. The AI pause that never was

The pause pledges vanished from policy debates while chipmakers shipped more compute than ever. What happened to the brakes?

2. Compute keeps doubling

Chipmakers are shipping more compute than ever, and your hardware costs and roadmap shift accordingly. The pause didn't slow them down.

3. Policy forgot the pause

Pause pledges quietly vanished from policy debates. That silence means your vendor's commitments from last year may no longer hold.

4. Your roadmap just moved

Your hardware costs and roadmap shift accordingly, but are you still planning around last year's promises? Check what your vendor committed to now.

5. Check your vendor's promises

Look up what your vendor committed to last year on AI pause. If those pledges are gone, your procurement strategy needs updating today.
